question: Скільки годин навчання було у 2025 році?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(f.hours),4) FROM fact_training f JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key JOIN dim_competence c ON c.competence_key = f.competence_key JOIN dim_employee e ON e.employee_sk = f.employee_sk JOIN dim_position p ON p.position_key = e.position_key JOIN dim_course co ON co.course_key = f.course_key WHERE d.year = 2025

question: Яка вартість навчання за роками?
gold_sql: SELECT d.year, ROUND(SUM(f.cost_eur),4) FROM fact_training f JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key JOIN dim_competence c ON c.competence_key = f.competence_key JOIN dim_employee e ON e.employee_sk = f.employee_sk JOIN dim_position p ON p.position_key = e.position_key JOIN dim_course co ON co.course_key = f.course_key GROUP BY d.year ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1

question: Яка вартість години навчання за класами у 2025 році?
gold_sql: SELECT c.class_label, ROUND(SUM(f.cost_eur)/SUM(f.hours),4) FROM fact_training f JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key JOIN dim_competence c ON c.competence_key = f.competence_key JOIN dim_employee e ON e.employee_sk = f.employee_sk JOIN dim_position p ON p.position_key = e.position_key JOIN dim_course co ON co.course_key = f.course_key WHERE d.year = 2025 GROUP BY c.class_label ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1

question: Скільки співробітників навчалось у 2026 році?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.employee_id) FROM fact_training f JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key JOIN dim_competence c ON c.competence_key = f.competence_key JOIN dim_employee e ON e.employee_sk = f.employee_sk JOIN dim_position p ON p.position_key = e.position_key JOIN dim_course co ON co.course_key = f.course_key WHERE d.year = 2026

question: Яка частка завершених курсів за провайдером?
gold_sql: SELECT co.provider_type, ROUND(1.0*SUM(f.completed)/COUNT(*),4) FROM fact_training f JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key JOIN dim_competence c ON c.competence_key = f.competence_key JOIN dim_employee e ON e.employee_sk = f.employee_sk JOIN dim_position p ON p.position_key = e.position_key JOIN dim_course co ON co.course_key = f.course_key GROUP BY co.provider_type ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1

question: Який середній приріст оцінки за підкласами?
gold_sql: SELECT c.subclass_label, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN f.completed=1 THEN f.score_after-f.score_before END),4) FROM fact_training f JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key JOIN dim_competence c ON c.competence_key = f.competence_key JOIN dim_employee e ON e.employee_sk = f.employee_sk JOIN dim_position p ON p.position_key = e.position_key JOIN dim_course co ON co.course_key = f.course_key GROUP BY c.subclass_label ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1

question: Топ 5 курсів за вартістю навчання
gold_sql: SELECT co.course_name, ROUND(SUM(f.cost_eur),4) FROM fact_training f JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key JOIN dim_competence c ON c.competence_key = f.competence_key JOIN dim_employee e ON e.employee_sk = f.employee_sk JOIN dim_position p ON p.position_key = e.position_key JOIN dim_course co ON co.course_key = f.course_key GROUP BY co.course_name ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 5

question: Скільки годин навчання за кварталами для технічних навичок?
gold_sql: SELECT d.year_quarter, ROUND(SUM(f.hours),4) FROM fact_training f JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key JOIN dim_competence c ON c.competence_key = f.competence_key JOIN dim_employee e ON e.employee_sk = f.employee_sk JOIN dim_position p ON p.position_key = e.position_key JOIN dim_course co ON co.course_key = f.course_key WHERE c.class_label = 'Технічні навички' GROUP BY d.year_quarter ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1

question: Яка вартість навчання за посадами у 2026 році?
gold_sql: SELECT p.position_name, ROUND(SUM(f.cost_eur),4) FROM fact_training f JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key JOIN dim_competence c ON c.competence_key = f.competence_key JOIN dim_employee e ON e.employee_sk = f.employee_sk JOIN dim_position p ON p.position_key = e.position_key JOIN dim_course co ON co.course_key = f.course_key WHERE d.year = 2026 GROUP BY p.position_name ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1

question: Скільки годин навчання припадає на кожного співробітника?
gold_sql: SELECT e.employee_name, ROUND(SUM(f.hours),4) FROM fact_training f JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key JOIN dim_competence c ON c.competence_key = f.competence_key JOIN dim_employee e ON e.employee_sk = f.employee_sk JOIN dim_position p ON p.position_key = e.position_key JOIN dim_course co ON co.course_key = f.course_key GROUP BY e.employee_name ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1

question: На скільки відсотків зросла вартість навчання у 2026 порівняно з 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0*(SUM(CASE WHEN d.year=2026 THEN f.cost_eur END)/SUM(CASE WHEN d.year=2025 THEN f.cost_eur END)-1),4) FROM fact_training f JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key JOIN dim_competence c ON c.competence_key = f.competence_key JOIN dim_employee e ON e.employee_sk = f.employee_sk JOIN dim_position p ON p.position_key = e.position_key JOIN dim_course co ON co.course_key = f.course_key

question: Які співробітники мають більше годин навчання, ніж середнє по компанії?
gold_sql: SELECT e.employee_name, ROUND(SUM(f.hours),4) FROM fact_training f JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key JOIN dim_competence c ON c.competence_key = f.competence_key JOIN dim_employee e ON e.employee_sk = f.employee_sk JOIN dim_position p ON p.position_key = e.position_key JOIN dim_course co ON co.course_key = f.course_key GROUP BY e.employee_name HAVING SUM(f.hours) > (SELECT SUM(hours)*1.0/COUNT(DISTINCT employee_sk) FROM fact_training) ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1

question: Порівняй вартість навчання у 2024 та 2025 роках
gold_sql: SELECT d.year, ROUND(SUM(f.cost_eur),4) FROM fact_training f JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key JOIN dim_competence c ON c.competence_key = f.competence_key JOIN dim_employee e ON e.employee_sk = f.employee_sk JOIN dim_position p ON p.position_key = e.position_key JOIN dim_course co ON co.course_key = f.course_key WHERE d.year IN (2024, 2025) GROUP BY d.year ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1
